system.description: After you perform an invocation during a conflict, you and up to one ally you can see increase one of your Attributes' die sizes by one (up to a maximum of d12). This increase lasts until the end of the scene or until you use this Skill again, and the Attribute is based on the wellspring you invoked: air (Insight), earth (one Attribute of your choice), fire (Dexterity), lightning (Might), or water (Willpower).
